name: syvna-ui-sdk
description: Syvna UI: the component library, its copy-in registry and CLI, and the MCP server for agents.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @syvna/ui && npm run dev -w docs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @syvna/ui && node packages/ui/scripts/registry.mjs && npm run build -w docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @syvna/ui && npm run typecheck -w docs
